title: Benjamin Clark
gist: This is an author archive/index page for Prospect's head of digital audience Benjamin Clark, not a standalone article — it lists his bio and headlines focused on the international populist right (British right, Orbán, Rupert Lowe on X) alongside left-economics figures (Zucman, Varoufakis), with no article body to analyze.

insights.claim: Benjamin Clark is Prospect's head of digital audience, previously worked for The Conversation, and is a long-time columnist for Crikey, an Australian outlet — giving him a cross-market (UK/Australia) vantage on populist politics.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Context for weighting his political commentary as coming from someone with comparative Anglophone media experience rather than a single-market specialist.
insights.quote: Benjamin Clark is head of digital audience. Originally from Australia, he has previously worked for The Conversation and is a long-time columnist for Crikey

insights.claim: Clark's listed headlines focus heavily on internal fractures within the international populist right, including 'The divided soul of the British right,' 'Anglofuturism and decline porn: the Brave New Worlds of the right,' Rupert Lowe's rise as 'the new star of Elon Musk's X,' and a video piece on Viktor Orbán's political fall as 'inspiration to Maga.'
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Indicates a sustained editorial focus at Prospect on right-populist movement fragmentation across the UK, Hungary and the US, worth watching as a recurring theme; only headlines are available here, not full text.

insights.claim: The same author's beat also features economist Gabriel Zucman's call for a wealth tax on the super-rich and coverage of Yanis Varoufakis, indicating parallel editorial attention to redistributive wealth-tax debates and European left-populist figures.
insights.speaker: Prospect Magazine
insights.so_what: Signals Prospect is actively tracking the global wealth-tax policy debate, relevant to monitoring political momentum behind wealth-tax proposals in Europe.
